description: The one authoritative coordinate chain for every Key West dataset. Inherited unchanged from the committed runtime crop (data/world/key_west/source_report.json) so existing gameplay anchors, chunk ids and terrain stay valid.
noaa_grid_note: NOAA DEM 6366 and the NOAA lidar point clouds are NAD83(2011) / UTM 17N. The DEM GeoTIFF is labelled EPSG:32617; the historical crop used that label. NOAA grids are therefore used as-is on the same UTM grid, and WGS84 vectors are projected EPSG:4326 -> EPSG:32617. The residual WGS84/NAD83(2011) realisation difference is measured, not assumed: see reports/alignment_report.json.
local_origin_derivation: Centre of the 2 m runtime crop: geotransform origin (415424, 2720288) + ((6602-1)*2/2, -(3286-1)*2/2).
units: 1 Godot unit = 1 metre; no scale factor is applied (UTM point scale ~0.99966 here, < 0.04 % length error, documented and not corrected so the runtime crop stays identical).

vertical.geoid: GEOID12B (DEM 6366); point clouds in laz/geoid18 are NAVD88 via GEOID18
vertical.godot_y: Godot Y = NAVD88 orthometric height in metres. Y = 0 is NAVD88 zero, not local mean sea level.
vertical.sea_level_convention: Runtime sea/ice plane sits at Y = 0 (NAVD88 0). The local MSL - NAVD88 offset at NOAA tide station 8724580 (Key West) has not been retrieved yet (tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov is blocked in the build environment); it must be recorded here before any tide-aware water level is used.
vertical.geoid12b_vs_geoid18: Not converted. The difference over Key West is centimetre-level and below the 0.15 m DEM vertical accuracy; recorded per source instead of silently mixed.

chunking.chunk_id: floor(x/512):floor(z/512) in local metres, identical to the existing city_preview chunk ids
chunking.assignment: A feature belongs to exactly one chunk: the chunk containing its representative point (shapely point_on_surface for areas, line midpoint for lines). Geometry is never cut at chunk borders.
